The protocol nonidentifiability sentence and PLAN.md state, before any fit, that a replicated linear noise contrast and a replicated leaf-versus-forest contrast do not identify one shared mechanism. evaluate copies that input sentence into the analysis. It projects confirmation time from the discovery wall-clock, two discovery draws, five confirmation draws, and safety factor 1.5. kept_full_menu is true when that projection is below 1800 seconds. Rows come from src.controlled_synthetic. The recorded linear noise score is the SNR 1 minus SNR 5 window mean of clean risk, gated by the SNR 1 interpolation flags at columns 150 and 250. The closed R2 primary noise contrast also carried a coefficient-norm component, and its evaluation size was 2000 rows; this protocol uses n_eval 1000 and stores the 20-column teacher-energy prefix on each linear cell. The 1.5 and 1800 thresholds are literals matching reduction_rule. runtime.torch_imported is the constant false, and the module source does not import torch.
